abstract: A 46-year-old man visited our hospital, complaining of fever and painful swelling of the right scrotum contents. The symptoms and signs suggested epididymitis, but testicular tumor could not be excluded. Therefore, high inguinal orchiectomy was performed. Macroscopic findings were compatible with the testicular teratoma, containing hair, and epididymitis. Histological findings revealed that the tumor was composed of mature epidermis with skin appendages, cartilage, hair, bone and adipose tissue, and that many leucocytes infiltrated in the epididymis, resulting in the diagnosis of pure mature teratoma with epididymitis. For 6 months after the operation, no evidence of recurrence has been observed. Despite its histologically benign appearance, primary pure teratoma of the testis has a metastatic and recurrent potential. Therefore, primary pure teratoma should be man aged in the same way as other nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.
abstract_ja: 46歳男性が発熱と右陰嚢内容の疼痛腫脹を主訴に来院した。症状と所見から副睾丸炎が疑われたが、精巣腫瘍は否定できなかった。そのため高位鼠径精巣摘除術を施行した。肉眼所見は、毛髪を含む精巣奇形腫と副睾丸炎に相当した。組織学的には、皮膚付属器を伴う成熟した表皮、軟骨、毛髪、骨、脂肪組織から成り、副睾丸には多数の白血球浸潤を認めた。その結果、副睾丸炎を伴う純粋成熟奇形腫と診断された。術後6か月間、再発の所見は認められていない。組織学的に良性の外観であっても、精巣原発の純粋奇形腫は転移・再発の可能性があるため、他の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と同様に管理すべきである。
